waypoints.name: Depot Creek Road Trailhead
waypoints.note: Depot Creek Road parking/trailhead (BC, Canada) — the shared trailhead for both Mox Peaks approaches, off Chilliwack Lake Road/Depot Creek Road; park at ~2,350 ft where the road becomes impassable.
waypoints.directions: From Trans-Canada Highway 1 Exit 119 in Chilliwack, BC, head south through Sardis and turn left onto Chilliwack Lake Road just before the river bridge. Follow it about 32 miles, past Chilliwack Lake, to the narrow, unsigned Depot Creek Road on the left near the lake's south end. High-clearance 4WD can go about 2.5 miles; park near 2,350 ft where the road becomes impassable. Carry a passport for the border.

waypoints.name: Northwest Mox Peak
waypoints.directions: Walk the old logging road about 2 miles to the US border and trail start, which climbs steeply to Depot Creek Falls; a climbers' path with fixed ropes passes the falls to Lake Ouzel (5,700 ft). Scramble the broken buttress southwest of the lake onto the Redoubt Glacier, traverse WSW about 2 miles to a flat near 7,300 ft, then contour southeast and climb the wet headwall at the glacier's eastern edge onto the northeast ridge to the summit.
